dex.entry: A tiny will-o'-wisp no bigger than a fist, its glow cycling between warm amber and drained grey as if the Hollowing pulls at something it refuses to release. It blinks in and out of visibility like a guttering candle. A kin visibly fighting its own hollowing — warm and dark at once, genuinely moving

art.silhouette: Teardrop wisp shape, half its body bathed in warm amber-white, half in cool ashen grey; the divide is not a clean line but a flickering blurred edge; tiny trailing tail of mist.
